page_subtitle.id: Berbelanja dengan tenang karena setiap produk didukung oleh komitmen penuh kami.
page_subtitle.en: Shop with confidence knowing every product is backed by our commitment.

desc_authentic.id:
Semua produk LUMINA Skincare dijamin 100% original, tersertifikasi resmi BPOM, dan bebas dari bahan berbahaya (merkuri, hidrokuinon, paraben keras). Kami mengambil produk langsung dari fasilitas manufaktur bersertifikasi cGMP.
Kami tidak mentoleransi produk tiruan.
desc_authentic.en:
All LUMINA Skincare products are guaranteed 100% authentic, officially BPOM certified, and free of hazardous chemicals. Sourced directly from cGMP-certified manufacturing laboratories.
We have zero tolerance for counterfeit items.

desc_inspection.id: Sebelum setiap pesanan dikirim, paket diperiksa segel keamanannya, kondisi botol/kemasan, dan tanggal kedaluwarsa (minimal 2 tahun ke depan) untuk menjamin kesegaran formula.
desc_inspection.en: Before shipment, every package undergoes security seal verification, bottle integrity checks, and expiration date validation (minimum 2 years remaining) to ensure formula potency.

desc_return_1.en: If your purchase does not meet your expectations, you can request a return within 7 days of purchase. The terms and conditions must be unused, authentic, including packaging and accessories. For more information, please visit the

desc_stringing.id: Formula kami dirancang hipoalergenik dan non-komedogenik. Jika Anda mengalami reaksi iritasi tak terduga dalam 7 hari pemakaian pertama, Beauty Advisor kami siap membantu penyesuaian atau pengembalian sesuai syarat berlaku.
desc_stringing.en: Our formulas are hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic. Should you encounter unexpected skin irritation within the first 7 days, our Beauty Advisors will guide your routine adjustment or handle eligible returns.

desc_support.id: Setiap jenis kulit memiliki kebutuhan unik. Tim Beauty Advisor LUMINA siap memberikan rekomendasi personal untuk jerawat, skin barrier rusak, penuaan dini, atau kulit kering.
desc_support.en: Every skin type is unique. The LUMINA Beauty Advisor team is ready to provide personalized guidance for acne, barrier damage, anti-aging, or dry skin concerns.

desc_secure.id: Penting untuk kami dalam menjamin privasi dan keamanan anda. Kami bekerja sama dengan pihak yang menyediakan metode pembayaran sesuai standar industri yang berlaku untuk melindungi data detail pembayaran pada proses checkout.
desc_secure.en: Ensuring your privacy and security is important to us. We partner with payment methods that comply with industry standards to protect your payment details during the checkout process.
